indexes.//: For pullUndatedEvents: where('startsAt','==',null) + orderBy('firstSeenAt','desc'). An equality filter plus an order on a DIFFERENT field is not covered by the automatic single-field indexes, unlike the dated query (a range and an order on startsAt itself), which is why only this one needs declaring. Missing it does not fail quietly: the feed reads nothing and shows the raw Firestore error.
